rules.description: opencode.jsonc MUST be generated from DUMMIE SSOT, never hand-edited for DUMMIE config
rules.enforcement: Guardian rule: detect opencode.jsonc in repo root and verify it matches generated output

rules.description: Plugin MUST route through MetaGateway, never bypass it
rules.enforcement: All chat.params hooks must call metagateway_discover or metagateway_cot_reason

rules.description: SDD guardrails MUST be checked before any remote tool execution
rules.enforcement: tool.execute.before hook must call sdd_remote_guard check

rules.description: Qwen3-Embedding MUST be the default routing embedding model
rules.enforcement: models_config.json must have qwen3-embedding as default embedding model

rules.description: dummie-opencode.service MUST exist and be after dummie-engine.service
rules.enforcement: scripts/systemd/ must contain dummie-opencode.service with After=dummie-engine.service

rules.description: Plugin MUST NOT hardcode model strings; MUST use SDK config
rules.enforcement: Guardian hardcoded-models rule must pass for plugin directory
